crossRefs.note: He went to his father’s house at Ophrah, and killed his brothers the sons of Jerubbaal, being seventy persons, on one…
All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by…
neither did they show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had…
In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
All the men of Shechem assembled themselves together with all the house of Millo, and went and made Abimelech king by…
“Then all the trees said to the bramble, ‘Come and reign over us.’
His concubine who was in Shechem also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: and you have risen up against my father’s house today and have slain his sons, seventy persons, on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his female servant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother);
translations.bsb: but you have risen up against my father’s house this day and killed his seventy sons on a single stone, and you have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the leaders of Shechem because he is your brother—
translations.kjv: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)
